name: 94040 · Mountain View, CA
findings: ZIP 94040 (Mountain View) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94040 (Mountain View) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94040 (Mountain View) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
